notes: The 401 (UnauthorizedResponse) example of GET /models verbatim. Not recordable: the recorder sends a valid key.

sanity_gaps.reason: known gap O33: ListModels drops an upstream error: on any status but 200 it returns a plain error ("list models returned status N") that is not a models.APIError and reads no body, so the status class, type, code and message are lost and a caller cannot tell a bad key from a rate limit or an outage. ListModels has no production caller today (cmd/contract-recorder's dispatch is the only one), so nothing serves this error to a client yet
